$description: UU DS design tokens. Units: px (app / Flutter dùng nguyên số này, logical px). Web: tokens.css xuất size / gap / radius / font-size / line-height theo rem = px ÷ 16, trừ size-px và rounded-circle.

overlay.$description: black at 10% — alpha applied at token level, not on a separate primitive.

overlay-strong.$description: black at 45% — lop phu DAM, dung de lam toi mot lop media (camera, anh, video) cho noi dung dat tren no noi len. Khac `overlay` (10%) von chi de tach lop cho dialog/sheet.

background-transparent.$description: white at 0% — alpha applied at token level, not on a separate primitive.

body.$description: Native system font of whatever OS is running. SF Pro is iOS's system font, not a UU DS font. Never bundle or self-host it.

display.$description: The only real brand typeface. Ships with the product. Used ONLY by display-* text styles.

density.$description: Collection density (Figma UU DLS). Mode touch = mặc định (kích thước gốc, app mobile / mini app); compact = desktop / dashboard. Web bật bằng data-density="compact" trên khung chứa; độc lập với brand. Giá trị là alias tới thang có sẵn; $resolved là px.
